crypto_algorithm_agility_justification: ABI fingerprints specify SHA-256 and are not user-negotiable; changing the digest requires a versioned format migration. They detect contract mismatch, not producer authentication. Release signing uses external certificate/Sigstore trust systems. Adding algorithm negotiation to the ABI is not justified solely for this badge. https://github.com/elide-dev/myna/blob/chore/best-practices-badge/SECURITY.md
crypto_credential_agility_justification: The distributed generator and value SDK do not authenticate users or process private signing keys. CI publishing credentials are independently managed by GitHub and the organization, not compiled into products.
crypto_used_network_justification: The distributed generator and value SDK have no network protocol or TLS client/server. Build-tool downloads use HTTPS with platform certificate verification; release delivery is separately covered by the passing delivery criteria.
crypto_tls12_justification: The distributed generator and value SDK have no network protocol or TLS client/server. Build-tool downloads use HTTPS with platform certificate verification; release delivery is separately covered by the passing delivery criteria.
crypto_certificate_verification_justific: The distributed generator and value SDK have no network protocol or TLS client/server. Build-tool downloads use HTTPS with platform certificate verification; release delivery is separately covered by the passing delivery criteria.
crypto_verification_private_justificatio: The distributed generator and value SDK have no network protocol or TLS client/server. Build-tool downloads use HTTPS with platform certificate verification; release delivery is separately covered by the passing delivery criteria.
signed_releases_justification: Current v0.9.1 source/SDK archives have original CI-generated signed Sigstore provenance; containers have digest-bound attestations. Consumer verification and public certificate material are documented. Historical unsigned artifacts are explicitly distinguished and not retroactively attested. https://github.com/elide-dev/myna/blob/chore/best-practices-badge/docs/releases.md ; https://github.com/elide-dev/myna/releases/tag/v0.9.1
version_tags_signed_justification: v0.9.1 X.509 tag signature verified locally and by GitHub on 2026-11-06. Public certificate and verification instructions: https://github.com/elide-dev/myna/blob/chore/best-practices-badge/docs/releases.md
hardening_justification: Managed Java and safe Rust provide bounds/lifetime protections, and native sanitizer canaries run in CI. These do not establish comprehensive hardening of distributed native binaries: Myna has not yet standardized or audited stack-protector/fortification flags across its LLVM and Native Image targets. Consumers control flags for the header-only C++ SDK; CPPFLAGS/CFLAGS/CXXFLAGS/LDFLAGS are honored. Runtime and raw-pointer limits: https://github.com/elide-dev/myna/blob/chore/best-practices-badge/SECURITY.md
